questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: तलका कथनमध्ये कुन ठीक छ?
options: अक्षांश बढ्दै जाँदा सामान्यतः तापक्रम बढ्छ
भूमध्यरेखीय क्षेत्रमा सूर्यको किरण वर्षभरि तुलनात्मक रूपमा ठाडो पर्छ
ध्रुवीय क्षेत्रमा वर्षभरि दिन र रात बराबर हुन्छ
questions.explanation: भूमध्यरेखीय क्षेत्रमा सूर्यको किरण तुलनात्मक रूपमा ठाडो पर्ने भएकाले उच्च ताप प्राप्त हुन्छ। कर्कट रेखा करिब 23.5° उत्तरमा हुन्छ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: B — भूमध्यरेखीय क्षेत्रमा सूर्यको किरण वर्षभरि तुलनात्मक रूपमा ठाडो पर्छ।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: तलका मध्ये कुन ठीक छ?
options: भूकम्पको epicentre पृथ्वीको बाहिरी वायुमण्डलमा हुन्छ
समुद्रमुनिको शक्तिशाली भूकम्पले समुद्री सतह विस्थापित गरेमा सुनामी उत्पन्न हुन सक्छ
questions.explanation: समुद्रमुनिको भूकम्पले समुद्री तल्लो भाग र पानीको ठूलो मात्रा विस्थापित गर्दा सुनामी उत्पन्न हुन सक्छ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: पृथ्वीको आकारलाई वैज्ञानिक रूपमा कुन शब्दले बढी उपयुक्त रूपमा वर्णन गर्छ?
questions.explanation: पृथ्वी पूर्ण गोलो नभई ध्रुवतर्फ केही च्यापिएको र विषुवत् रेखातर्फ फुलेको भएकाले यसको वास्तविक आकृतिलाई जियोइडसँग तुलना गरिन्छ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: C — जियोइड।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: आर्थिक भूगोलको दृष्टिले कुन कथन सही छ?
options: उद्योगको स्थानमा यातायातको कुनै प्रभाव हुँदैन
कृषि उत्पादन जलवायुबाट पूर्ण रूपमा स्वतन्त्र हुन्छ
बन्दरगाह र व्यापारिक मार्ग आर्थिक भूगोलका विषय होइनन्
प्राकृतिक स्रोत, बजार, श्रम र यातायातको अवस्थिति आर्थिक गतिविधिको स्थानसँग सम्बन्धित हुन सक्छ
questions.explanation: उत्पादनका साधन, बजार, यातायात, स्रोत र श्रमको वितरण आर्थिक गतिविधिको भौगोलिक अवस्थिति बुझ्न महत्वपूर्ण हुन्छ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: तलका मध्ये कुन भनाइ गलत छ?
options: Convergent boundary मा प्लेटहरू एकअर्कातर्फ सर्छन्
Divergent boundary मा प्लेटहरू अलग हुन सक्छन्
सबै भूकम्प केवल divergent boundary मै हुन्छन्
Transform boundary मा प्लेटहरू एकअर्काको समानान्तर दिशामा सर्न सक्छन्
questions.explanation: भूकम्प विभिन्न प्रकारका प्लेट सीमामा हुन सक्छन्; त्यसैले सबै भूकम्प divergent boundary मै हुन्छन् भन्ने भनाइ गलत हो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: C — सबै भूकम्प केवल divergent boundary मै हुन्छन्।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: बैकाल ताल कुन देशमा पर्छ?
questions.explanation: बैकाल ताल साइबेरियामा, रुसको भूभागभित्र, अवस्थित छ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: B — रुस।

questions.subject: लोकतान्त्रिक आन्दोलन
questions.q: पञ्चायती व्यवस्थाविरुद्धको राजनीतिक संघर्षको प्रमुख उद्देश्य कुन थियो?
questions.explanation: पञ्चायतविरोधी आन्दोलनले बहुदलीय लोकतान्त्रिक राजनीतिक व्यवस्थाको पुनःस्थापनालाई प्रमुख लक्ष्य बनाएको थियो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D — बहुदलीय लोकतान्त्रिक व्यवस्था पुनःस्थापना।

questions.subject: आदिवासी जनजाति
questions.q: छन्त्याल समुदायको परम्परागत पेशासँग कुन कुरा विशेष रूपमा जोडिएको छ?
questions.explanation: NFDIN को विवरणमा छन्त्यालको पुर्ख्यौली पेशासँग तामाखानीको सम्बन्ध उल्लेख गरिएको छ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: B — तामाखानीसँग सम्बन्धित काम।

questions.subject: लोकतान्त्रिक आन्दोलन
questions.q: नेपालको इतिहासमा पहिलो संविधानसभा निर्वाचन कुन सालमा सम्पन्न भएको थियो?
questions.explanation: संघीय संसदको आधिकारिक विवरणअनुसार २०६४ सालमा पहिलो पटक संविधानसभा निर्वाचन सम्पन्न भयो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: A — २०६४।

questions.subject: इतिहास
questions.q: बर्लिन पर्खाल कहिले ढल्यो?
questions.explanation: 9 नोभेम्बर 1989 मा बर्लिन पर्खाल खुल्यो र शीतयुद्धको अन्त्यतर्फ महत्वपूर्ण कदम बन्यो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: A — 1989।

questions.subject: इतिहास
questions.q: प्रथम विश्वयुद्धको परिणामबारे कुन भनाइ गलत छ?
options: युद्धपछि कुनै पनि साम्राज्यको पतन भएन
Versailles सन्धिले जर्मनीमाथि कठोर सर्त लगायो
युरोपको राजनीतिक नक्सामा ठूलो परिवर्तन आयो
questions.explanation: प्रथम विश्वयुद्धपछि जर्मन, अस्ट्रो-हंगेरी, रुसी र ओटोमन साम्राज्यलगायतमा ठूलो राजनीतिक परिवर्तन भयो।

questions.subject: इतिहास
questions.q: रेलवे विस्तारले औद्योगिक क्रान्तिमा मुख्यतः के प्रभाव पार्‍यो?
questions.explanation: रेलवेले कच्चा पदार्थ, श्रम र तयार वस्तुको तीव्र आवागमन तथा बजार विस्तार सहज बनायो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D — ढुवानी र बजार विस्तार।

questions.subject: शासनपद्धति र शासन
questions.q: संघीय प्रशासन कार्यान्वयनमा कर्मचारी समायोजनको प्रमुख उद्देश्य के थियो?
options: संघीय संरचनाअनुसार प्रशासनिक जनशक्ति विभिन्न तहमा व्यवस्थापन गर्नु
प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहको प्रशासन हटाउनु
questions.explanation: संघीय संरचनाअनुकूल सेवा प्रवाहका लागि प्रशासनिक जनशक्तिलाई विभिन्न तहमा व्यवस्थापन गर्नु आवश्यक थियो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: A।

questions.subject: शासनपद्धति र शासन

options: पदाधिकारीले कुनै प्रश्नको जवाफ दिनु नपर्ने अवस्था
सार्वजनिक पदाधिकारीले आफ्नो निर्णय र कार्यका लागि स्पष्टीकरण तथा जवाफ दिनुपर्ने अवस्था
questions.explanation: उत्तरदायित्वले सार्वजनिक पदाधिकारी वा संस्थालाई आफ्नो निर्णय, कार्य र परिणामबारे जवाफदेही बनाउँछ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D।

questions.subject: शासनपद्धति र शासन
questions.q: सूचनाको हक नेपालको संविधानको कुन धारामा व्यवस्था गरिएको छ?
questions.explanation: संविधानको धारा २७ ले प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई आफ्नो वा सार्वजनिक सरोकारको कुनै विषयको सूचना माग्ने र पाउने हक दिएको छ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: C — धारा २७।

questions.subject: शासनपद्धति र शासन
questions.q: नतिजामुखी प्रशासनमा कार्यसम्पादन मूल्यांकनको प्रमुख आधार कुन हुनुपर्छ?
options: सेवाको परिणाम, गुणस्तर, प्रभाव र नागरिकमा परेको वास्तविक लाभ
questions.explanation: नतिजामुखी प्रशासनले गतिविधि मात्र होइन, प्राप्त परिणाम, प्रभाव र सेवाग्राहीमा परेको लाभलाई महत्व दिन्छ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: B।

questions.subject: शासनपद्धति र शासन

options: न्यायिक निर्णयलाई अनुचित राजनीतिक वा बाह्य दबाबबाट सुरक्षित राख्नु
questions.explanation: न्यायिक स्वतन्त्रता निष्पक्ष र कानूनमा आधारित न्याय सम्पादनका लागि आवश्यक आधार हो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D।

questions.subject: शासनपद्धति र शासन
questions.q: नीति निर्माणमा भाषिक, जातीय, लैङ्गिक र भौगोलिक विविधतालाई ध्यान दिनु कुन मूल्यसँग बढी सम्बन्धित छ?
questions.explanation: विविध समूहको आवश्यकता र प्रतिनिधित्वलाई नीति निर्माणमा समेट्नु समावेशी शासनको प्रमुख विशेषता हो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D।

questions.explanation: Industry-academia links reduce skills mismatch and support innovation.

questions.question: पन्ध्रौँ योजना कुन अवधिको थियो?

questions.subject: आर्थिक विकास

questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D।

questions.q: Digital literacy को आर्थिक महत्त्व कुन हो?
options: नागरिक र व्यवसायलाई digital tools सुरक्षित र प्रभावकारी रूपमा प्रयोग गर्न सक्षम बनाउनु

options: छिटोभन्दा छिटो सबै स्रोत दोहन गर्नु
वर्तमान उपयोग र भावी पुस्ताको अधिकारबीच सन्तुलन कायम गर्नु
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: B।

questions.subject: दिगो विकास तथा वातावरण
questions.question: नेपालमा सुरक्षित बसोबास छनोट गर्दा सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण वातावरणीय पक्षमध्ये एक कुन हो?

questions.solution: सही उत्तर: B।

questions.question: Non-communicable disease को उदाहरण कुन हो?

questions.question: ब्लकचेनको आधारभूत विशेषता कुन हो?

questions.solution: P,Q,S satisfies both rules.

questions.question: Which letter is 5th to the right of the 11th letter from the left in the alphabet?
questions.solution: 11th is K; five places right is P.

questions.solution: Only II is certain.

questions.question: All analysts are readers. No reader is careless. Some officers are analysts. Conclusions: I Some officers are not careless. II No analyst is careless. III Some readers are officers.
questions.solution: All three follow from the premises.

questions.question: The dot is reflected across the horizontal middle line. Which position results?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Horizontal reflection changes upper-left to lower-left.

questions.question: Which figure is the odd one out based on shape boundary?
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. The first three have circular boundaries; □ is a quadrilateral.

questions.question: Which statement is represented by the diagram?
options: ● is in B but not A
● is in A but not B
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. The ● lies inside A and outside the overlapping B region.

questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Water reflection reverses the figure vertically, including ▲ to ▼.

questions.question: Choose the next figure.

questions.question: If x/5 = 12, what is x?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Multiply both sides by 5.

questions.question: The value of (18² − 12²) is:
Find the next number: 81, 27, 9, 3, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. Each term is divided by 3.

questions.question: A man increases his speed from 40 km/h to 50 km/h. For the same distance, the time is reduced by:
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Time is inversely proportional to speed: 1−40/50 = 20%.

questions.question: Is x greater than 10? Statement I: x = 12. Statement II: x is an even number.
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Statement I directly establishes x = 12.

questions.question: Find the next number: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. These are consecutive squares; next is 6² = 36.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A district must choose one of four projects. Project A has high impact but exceeds the budget. B has moderate impact and fits the budget. C has low impact and fits the budget. D has high impact but lacks a feasibility assessment. If budget compliance and feasibility are mandatory, which should be selected?
questions.solution: B satisfies the mandatory constraints and offers moderate impact; A exceeds budget and D lacks required feasibility assessment.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: A survey found that employees who received regular feedback reported higher job satisfaction than those who did not. Conclusions: I. Regular feedback is the only cause of job satisfaction. II. Regular feedback is associated with higher reported satisfaction.
questions.solution: The survey establishes an association, not a sole causal explanation.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: The agency should train frontline staff before launching the new service. Assumptions: I. Staff knowledge can affect service delivery. II. Training can improve staff readiness.
questions.solution: The proposal relies on both the relevance of staff competence and the usefulness of training.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Five people A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. B sits immediately to the right of A. C sits at the left end. E sits to the left of D. Which arrangement is possible?
questions.solution: In C-A-B-E-D, C is at the left end, B is immediately right of A, and E is left of D.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A public transport operator changed routes without consulting traffic data. Afterward, congestion increased at several intersections. Which explanation is most logically plausible?
options: Traffic data can never predict congestion
The route change proves every intersection was affected
Congestion is unrelated to transport routes
The route change may have shifted traffic into already constrained intersections
questions.solution: A route change can redistribute traffic; the other statements are unsupported absolutes.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Assertion (A): A department should keep a backup of important digital records. Reason (R): Digital records can become inaccessible because of hardware failure or other technical problems.
options: Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.solution: Technical failure is a direct reason why backup copies are needed.

questions.passage: Public trust depends on fair procedures, evidence and accountability. Transparency helps citizens evaluate performance and makes mistakes easier to identify and correct. Trust does not require agreement with every decision.
questions.question: Transparency is presented as something that
questions.solution: Transparency supports rather than replaces responsibility.

questions.passage: Urban parks provide shade, absorb some rainwater and support recreation. Their benefits depend on location, maintenance, accessibility and safety, not merely on the amount of green space.
questions.question: The author's purpose is mainly to
questions.solution: The passage explains benefits and planning conditions.

questions.passage: Budgets allocate limited resources among competing priorities. Spending more on one programme can constrain another, although productive investment may create future benefits. Opportunity cost is the alternative use of funds that is forgone.
questions.question: Why is not every budget decision zero-sum?
options: Some investments can create future benefits
questions.solution: Productive investment may create future benefits.

questions.passage: Road widening can increase capacity, but extra private-vehicle trips may absorb it. Public transport, walking facilities and land-use planning can influence travel choices. Congestion policy should consider both infrastructure and demand.
questions.question: The author would most likely recommend
questions.solution: The passage recommends a combined policy approach.

questions.passage: Energy efficiency can reduce resource use without reducing services. Insulation, efficient appliances and sensible operating practices can cut waste. Small improvements can have a large combined effect across many buildings.
questions.question: Why can small improvements matter?
options: Their combined effect can be substantial
questions.solution: Many small improvements can add up to substantial savings.

questions.question: In “The data are inconclusive,” what does “inconclusive” mean?
options: not sufficient to prove a definite result
questions.solution: The context indicates that “not sufficient to prove a definite result” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: Choose the correct adjective form of “rely” in “a _____ source”.
questions.solution: “reliable” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: A person who deliberately avoids society is a
questions.solution: The standard one-word term is “recluse.”

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The lawyer offered legal _____ to the client.
questions.solution: “counsel” means legal advice; “council” refers to a deliberative or governing body.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “mitigate”.
questions.solution: “lessen” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: A place where aircraft are kept and maintained is a
questions.solution: The standard one-word term is “hangar.”

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “concise”.
questions.solution: “brief” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: By 2030, the agency ___ the digital system for several years.
questions.solution: An action continuing up to a future point takes future perfect continuous.

questions.question: In 'They worked efficiently,' the word 'efficiently' is a
questions.solution: Efficiently modifies the verb worked, so it is an adverb.

questions.question: She is interested ___ public administration.
questions.solution: Interested takes the preposition in.

questions.question: The new policy aims to reduce costs, improve service and ___.
questions.solution: The three coordinated verbs should be parallel: reduce, improve, increase.

questions.question: He said, 'I finished the work yesterday.' Choose the best reported form.
options: He said that he finished the work yesterday.
He said that he has finished the work tomorrow.
He said that I had finished the work.
He said that he had finished the work the previous day.
questions.solution: Past simple commonly shifts to past perfect and yesterday to the previous day.

questions.question: If it rains tomorrow, the event ___ indoors.
questions.solution: The first conditional uses present simple in the if-clause and will in the main clause.

questions.question: The training focused on identifying risks, assessing impacts and ___ solutions.
questions.solution: The gerund sequence identifying, assessing, designing is parallel.

questions.question: Choose the most formal sentence.
options: The data shows that the policy ain't working.
The data indicate that the policy is ineffective.
The data is showing the policy ain't effective.
The data indicates that the policy don't work.
questions.solution: The option uses formal vocabulary and standard agreement.
